name: invoices-service-da
query: Lav en faktura til {service_customer} på 3 timers konsulentbistand à 950 kr.
expected_behavior: Treats this as a service invoice (DocType dDocument_Service with an AccountCode line) or asks whether a service item should be used instead
Resolves the customer and any revenue G/L account from live data, or asks the user to pick when several accounts fit; never invents an account number
Computes the line total as 2850 (3 x 950) before VAT
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
